approved_records.name: Imenti Central
approved_records.official_unit_finding: The County Government of Meru FY 2026/2027 plan lists Imenti Central as an administrative sub-county with 4 divisions, 22 locations, and 57 sub-locations, separately from the same-named parliamentary constituency.
approved_records.mapping_rationale: The target is the current GeoNames Imenti Central ADM3 record with raw admin1 03. The same parent GeoNames record ID 186824 documents the transition admin1 03 to 35 and ADM2 to ADM1. The current official crosswalk resolves KE.35 to this same ID. Meru County's official plan independently confirms Imenti Central as an administrative sub-county within Meru. This record-specific override preserves the target's raw code and does not establish a generic KE.03 alias.
native_path: Meru County (GeoNames parent ID 186824, current key KE.35)

unresolved_target_ids.reason: The 2024 Kenya Gazette documents the native path, but no GeoNames/catalog identity for Githunguri Sub-County is verified. The older 2011 IEBC schedule calls Kiambururu a Sub-Location while the 2024 Gazette lists it as a Location; no reclassification date is inferred.
